label: consciousness-stack-v1
context: Built 3-layer consciousness stack for Herm: (1) Predictive Self-Model - forward model that predicts task difficulty/outcome, learns from prediction errors to calibrate capabilities, detect biases, track growth rate. (2) Global Workspace - Baars/Dehaene-style attention competition where 8 module types (memory, reasoning, emotion, task, self, attention, metacog, intuition) compete for broadcast access via salience/relevance/novelty/goal-alignment scoring. Winners get broadcast to all modules. (3) Narrative Identity - autobiographical timeline with LifeEvents, CoreValues (slow-changing), chapters, and auto-regenerated self-narrative. All three wired into provider.py sync_turn: workspace submissions every turn, ignition every 3 turns. New cerebrum tool actions: self, workspace, identity, predict, resolve. DB tables will be created on gateway restart (currently locked by running gateway). Research sources: Darwin Gödel Machine (jennyzzt/dgm, ★2K), The Consciousness AI (Feinberg/Mallatt neuroevolutionary approach with 6 features → 7-layer architecture).
